arguments.description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet.

criteria.scope: Corrected future contract for the representative Ready status sample (queue.ready), written after delivery of candidate ready.retained under the historical plan work/queue.ready-revision/candidate-plan.json (sha256 e7f85aa1f115b4f4c40cc5fc7c6e16a6313b4db36df4d133823241b9923750f6). It is a proposal for any future Ready revision or re-review. It does not retroactively replace the contract used for delivery, does not transplant that delivery's verdicts, and does not authorize a new provider request (PHASE.md lines 2-11). Only this sample's own mechanical, meaning, readability and accent checks bind here. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused versus Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and destination acceptance remain later-stage obligations recorded in request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

comparisons.check: Decoded RGBA carries an alpha channel; fully transparent (alpha 0) pixels exist; opaque pixels do not cover the entire 16x16 canvas. The count of fractional-alpha pixels is recorded as a measurement with no pass threshold (binary alpha is not required).
comparisons.basis: Owner brief: BRIEF.md line 3 requires transparent backgrounds and line 9 keeps the transparent background; the brief does not restrict alpha to binary values. This measurement establishes only that transparency is present; it cannot decide which opaque shape is subject and which is an unwanted matte, so that judgment is a separate visual criterion.

comparisons.check: Viewed on the transparent native view and composited on #172336 at 1x and 3x, the area around the mark reads as the panel showing through: no unintended opaque matte, box, halo or fringe surrounds the mark. An opaque plate or backing shape is acceptable only when it is a deliberate part of the mark's design rather than an unremoved canvas fill.
comparisons.basis: Owner brief: BRIEF.md line 3 and line 9 require a transparent background. Deciding which opaque shape is intentional foreground is a visual judgment, so it is split from the alpha measurement (request-review route guidance). #172336 is the consumer-observed panel colour (src/queue-view.ts line 9) used for compositing.

comparisons.check: Viewed alone at native and 3x scale, the mark is visibly a check mark whose two arms are asymmetrical (in length, angle, thickness, curvature or position; the brief does not fix which) and it conveys successful completion. By itself it must not resemble the idle Start triangle (assets/start.svg), a spinner or activity loop, pause bars, or an error/retry symbol. Pairwise comparison with actual Working, Retry and Paused art is a later family obligation and is not part of this check.
comparisons.basis: Owner requirement: BRIEF.md line 9 requires a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. comparisons.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: coherent pixel clusters with regular stair-step runs on intended diagonals, no unintended isolated pixels, no accidental resampling blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly extend to Working, Retry and Paused. Deliberate selective anti-aliasing and intentional single-pixel details are permitted when they read as part of the mark.
comparisons.basis: Specialist expert judgment (edge-rhythm and semantic-cluster methods) applying BRIEF.md line 3 'Create coherent pixel-art status assets' and line 5's representative-sample instruction. Wording now distinguishes accidental resampling from authored anti-aliasing because the contract permits full alpha. Passing does not approve the family style.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
requirements.reason: Decoded PNG is 16x16 with one static frame; no strip or extra canvas.

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: 227 pixels are RGBA 0,0,0,0; 29 subject pixels are opaque blue. Transparent exterior and open corners have no matte or fringe; no binary-alpha rule imposed.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
requirements.reason: Viewed native and 3x: a short descending left arm joins a distinctly longer ascending right arm into a clear check mark. It reads as successful completion rather than triangle, pause bars, loop or failure.

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
requirements.reason: Native 16x16 panel composite shows a recognizable light-blue check; 48x48 nearest composite preserves clear steps and essential asymmetrical arms against #172336.

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent
requirements.check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.
requirements.reason: Visible sky-blue treatment relates directly to the preserved Start SVG's cool-blue cue; measured color happens to equal #70b9ed, but exact equality was not a rejection rule.

requirements.name: sample-pixel-craft
requirements.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
requirements.reason: Viewed all native and enlarged views: compact connected stepped clusters form a crisp check without blur, isolated noise or downscaled illustration artifacts. A plausible sample for future family extension; family adoption and comparisons remain separate.
